name: Tajima Takahisa
source:
A young man from their school [spoiler]who is a pyrokinetic[/spoiler]. He is in the same grade as [url=https://vndb.org/c3122]Yuka[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c3121]Kakeru[/url], but is not from their class. His personality is brash and that of a loner and is easily identified with a grey mullet. He is now under the guardianship of [url=https://vndb.org/c3143]Saeko[/url]. [spoiler]In his childhood, he was trying his best to survive after his parents abandoned him. Saeko was the one that took him in, but he has little to no respect for her in spite of that. Despite this, he actually cares for her.

He may not look like it, but despite his appearance, he's actually a quick witted and adaptable person, especially in tight situations. As the story progresses, he falls in love with [url=https://vndb.org/c3137]Yukiko[/url].[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/11eyes:_Tsumi_to_Batsu_to_Aganai_no_Sh%C5%8Djo]Wikipedia[/url].]
